alternatives.description: Keep public prototype and private kernel DesignEpoch semantics independently tested without shared vectors.
alternatives.projected_effect: Local tests can pass while equivalent mechanisms drift semantically across repositories.

alternatives.description: Bind a small DesignEpoch semantic vector set to v15.5/source-root and test current public prototype against the private kernel in CI.
alternatives.projected_effect: Equivalent CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN behavior becomes machine-comparable without merging implementations.
alternatives.risk: SCEP and non-DesignEpoch duplicate semantics remain explicit FRONTIER.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING cannot mechanically detect public/private semantic drift.
Shared-vector CI adds an external public-repo dependency and still does not prove full semantic equivalence.

assumptions: Current public garden-swarm DesignEpoch reference is public material and can be checked by private CI.
Scoped vector compatibility is evidence only and cannot authorize or certify.
reason.uncertainty: SCEP/bootstrap and duplicate semantics outside DesignEpoch freshness remain untested by this slice; public main can also evolve independently after a run.
counterexamples: A stale DesignEpoch must remain STALE in both implementations.
Missing dependency-closure declaration must remain UNKNOWN in both implementations.
A missing current dependency must remain UNKNOWN rather than becoming CURRENT.
reason.conclusion: Admit only a bounded public/private DesignEpoch compatibility gate, preserve SCEP as FRONTIER, and leave ActionGate as the sole authorization owner.

obligations.statement: Shared vector content is hash-bound and current for v15.5/source-root.
Public prototype and private kernel return compatible statuses/reason prefixes for every bounded DesignEpoch vector.
SCEP absence remains explicit FRONTIER and is not counted as semantic convergence.
Duplicate-semantics conformance cannot authorize actions or promote canon.

items.claim_scope: Requires duplicate-semantics convergence through shared schemas and conformance vectors.
Public reference has explicit CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN freshness semantics.
